connectorUiConfig.title: Firecrawl Scrape Activity (Push)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Pushes Firecrawl scrape activity into Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. The customer-owned DCR normalizes native events into ASimWebSessionLogs.

sampleQueries.query: ASimWebSessionLogs | where EventVendor == "Firecrawl" | sort by TimeGenerated desc
ASimWebSessionLogs | where EventVendor == "Firecrawl" and DvcAction == "Deny" | project TimeGenerated, SrcUsername, Url, RuleName, ThreatCategory, EventSeverity

dataTypes.name: ASimWebSessionLogs
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: ASimWebSessionLogs | where EventVendor == "Firecrawl" | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

value: ASimWebSessionLogs | where EventVendor == "Firecrawl" | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated) | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra
customs.description: Permission to create an app registration and client secret.

customs.name: Microsoft Azure
customs.description: Permission to assign Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the data collection rule.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the push connector resources
instructionSteps.description: Create the data collection endpoint, data collection rule, Entra application, and role assignment.

parameters.content: The DCR transforms Firecrawl's native scrape activity schema into ASimWebSessionLogs. Review the transform before deployment because it is controlled by your workspace.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Firecrawl
instructionSteps.description: Copy the generated values into the Firecrawl Enterprise Controls SIEM form.
